source: Final delivered GLB buffers, canonical skinning using each vertex actual normalized weights and inverse bind matrices
method: 60Hz plus exact events/support boundaries. Every skinned vertex is floor-scanned. At each contact midpoint the nearest real mesh triangle is recorded with vertex IDs and barycentric coordinates; those actual skinned triangle points are followed throughout the declared interval.
limitations: The hand endpoint is the wrist-joint center; it lies about 1cm within the real hand surface. Surface gaps are diagnostic Euclidean distances between calibrated real triangle points. This is not a full continuous interpenetration, palm orientation, garment collision, or biomechanical certification. A contact marker may be close to a triangle while the contacted hand uses another surface.
